records.text: No build record on disk. prepare_over_corpus(corpus) only calls build_sparse_index(corpus): it reads the corpus records (products/*.json, and the employee, customer and team directory files when METADATA_ON), tokenizes them with bm25s (English stopwords, PyStemmer 'english') and indexes them with bm25s.BM25(k1=K1, b=B, method='lucene') in memory. Nothing is written to a file. Its record is BuildStats(build_time_s, models=[]) and index_info(), which says 'kept': 'in memory, built at the start of every leg' and gives units, text_chars, units_sha256, k1, b and the bm25s and PyStemmer versions for the run manifest, that is, inside the run folder.
